reviews.review_description:
Ever wanted to be Lucky Luke? Wild West Panic drops you smack-dab in the middle of a cartoon Wild West where every shot counts! Dodge bullets, protect civilians (and animals—except vultures, shoot ‘em all), and rack up that bounty. The art? Pure Paper Mario charm meets Wild West chaos—bright, bold, and bursting with personality.
From the first trigger pull, this game doesn’t let up. It’s a whirlwind of precision, reflexes, and pure adrenaline. You’ll twist your wrist like a seasoned gunslinger, willing every bullet to fly true. Miss a shot? A civilian or critter takes the hit—and your precious bounty vanishes. The pressure’s on!
Unlock achievements, tackle challenges, and master the art of the quick draw. Each level climaxes in a boss showdown that’ll test your mettle—dodging, aiming, and praying for that perfect shot. The controls? Responsive. The stakes? Sky-high. The fun? Endless.
Boss fights are no joke—epic, sweat-inducing battles that’ll leave you grinning (or groaning) for more. Whether you’re a sharpshooter or a rookie, Wild West Panic is a love letter to classic shooters, wrapped in a vibrant, chaotic package.
So holster up, take aim, and panic your way to victory! The frontier’s waitin’—and it’s bullet time. 🎯💥

Fun shooter and definitely more challenging that it seems at first, you really need to be precise, especially with the moving targets and the boss!

I really got into it trying to hit them, which was a lot of fun. Would definitely love to see more different weapons in the game.

Also really like the different types of environments! 5 stars!

The Wild West Panic is a fantastic surprise on the Meta Quest! The wild west atmosphere is spot on, the graphics fit the style perfectly, and the gameplay is intuitive, fast-paced, and highly addictive.

The gunplay feels super satisfying and the action keeps you on your toes the entire time. It's the perfect game to jump into for an intense, fun VR session. If you enjoy cowboy themes and dynamic VR shooters, you really can't go wrong with this one. Highly recommended addition to any Quest library!

reviews.review_title: Addictingly fun Wild West arcade shooter
reviews.review_description: There’s just something fun and addicting trying to best your best score. Simple but very western shooter game where you shoot targets as efficiently and quickly as possibly in different settings. Nice little fun twist is a “boss” appears and that’s when you really have to be on your A game before time runs out! Watch out on shooting the innocent bystanders though or that’ll negatively impact your score! Great fun for all. Highly recommend if looking for an epic fun arcade style shooter!
